items.text: Suleman ulund ucoko judongo mir Israel, man wi suru ceke, judongomawijo mi udi pa wego mi nyithindho mir Israel, bang’ ubimo ma Suleman i Yerusalem, kara gikel sanduk mi lembariba pa Yehova malu ku i adhura pa Daudi, ma en e Sayuni.
E dhanu ceke mir Israel gicokri gigi bang’ ubimo ma Suleman i agba, i dwi Ethanim,
Ethanim = dwi mir abirone mi Juyahudi, dwi mur abing’wende ku mir apje mi oro mwa.
ma en e dwi mir abirone.
E judongo mir Israel ceke gibino, man julam giting’o sanduk.
Man gikelo sanduk pa Yehova malu, ku hema mi cokri, kud agulu ceke ma leng’ ma ni i Hema; julam ku Julawi gikelo maeni malu.
Man ubimo ma Suleman ku cokri ceke mir Israel, ma gicokri i bang’e, gini karacelo kude i wang’ sandukne, ma gibelamu rombe ku koni dhiang’, ma jucopo kwanu ngo kadi ng’eyo welne de ni udulne.
Man julam gikelo sanduk mi lembariba pa Yehova i kakare, i kayerlembe mi ot, ba kamaleng’ m’usagu, en e the bomb kerubi.
Kum kerubi giyaru bombgi wi kaka sanduk, man kerubi giumo sanduk ku yende ku malu.
Man yende bedo bor hai ketho nia dhu yende nen kud i kamaleng’ i wang’ kayerlembe; ento ginen ungo ku yo woko: man gibedo keca cil i ceng’ ma tin.
Poi 10:5
Gin moko mbe i sandukne ndhu bankidi ario ma Musa ketho keca i Horeb, kinde ma Yehova timo lembariba ku nyithindho mir Israel, kinde ma giai woko kud i ng’om Misiri.
Man etimbre, kinde ma julam uai woko kud i kamaleng’, nia afuru pong’o ot pa Yehova,
ketho nia julam copo cungo ngo kum timo ni kum afurune; kum der pa Yehova pong’o ot pa Yehova.
Suleman ulund uwacu kumae, Yehova wacu nia ebibedo i mudho ma bii.
Agomo iri ot mi bedo andha, ka m’ibed i ie mi nja.
Man ubimo loko wang’e, e emio mugisa ni cokri ceke mir Israel: man cokri ceke mir Israel ucungo.
E ewacu kumae, Mugisa bed ni Yehova, Mungu mir Israel, m’eyero ku dhoge ni Daudi ma vwa, man eketho etimbre kakare ku cinge, m’ewacu kumae,

Ugambre i ceng’ m’awodho ie dhanu para Israel woko kud i Misiri, agoyo wi adhura moko ngo, kud i suru ceke mir Israel ya jugom ie ot, kara nyinga bed keca; ento agoyo wi Daudi kara ebed wi dhanu para Israel.
Nie ebedo i adunde Daudi ma vwa kara egom ot pi nying’ Yehova, Mungu mir Israel.
Ento Yehova wacu ni Daudi ma vwa kumae, Kum ebedo i adundeni ya igom ot pi nyinga, itimo dre kum ebedo i adundeni:
ento ibigomo ot ungo; ento wodi ma biai kud i i, e m’ebigomo ot pi nyinga.
Man Yehova ketho lembe m’eyero cungo; kum juting’a malu ka Daudi ma vwa, man ajany wi komker mir Israel, calu Yehova ng’olo, man agomo ot pi nying’ Yehova, Mungu mir Israel.
Man aketho kaka sanduk keca ma lembariba pa Yehova ni i ie, m’etimo ku kwaruwagi, kinde m’ewodhogi woko kud i ng’om Misiri.
Man Suleman ucungo i wang’ pemblam pa Yehova i vut cokri ceke mir Israel, man ethang’u cinge yor i polo:
man ewacu kumae, E Yehova, Mungu mir Israel, Mungu moko mbe ma calu in, malu i polo, kadi piny i ng’om; m’ugwoko lembariba ku mer mi bero Jeu jutic peri, m’uwotho i weng’i kud adundegi ceke;
m’igwoko wuku jatic peri Daudi ma vwa lembe m’ing’olo ire: eyo, iyero ku dhogi, man itime kakare ku cingi, calu ebedo i ceng’ ma tin.

Ka kumeno kawono, E Yehova, Mungu mir Israel, gwok ku jatic peri ma Daudi ma vwa lembe m’ing’olo ire, m’iwacu kumae, Dhanu bibedo umbe ngo iri i wang’a m’ubed wi komker mir Israel, tek nyithindho peri giketho cwinygi kum yo migi kende, kara giwoth i wang’a calu iwotho i wang’a.
Ka kumeno kawono, E Mungu mir Israel, akwei, wek lembe peri bed andha, m’iyero ni jatic peri ma Daudi ma vwa.
2 Kei 2:6
Ento Mungu bibedo wi ng’om andha? nen, polo man polo m’i polo copo romi ngo; e ka ot maeni m’agomo biromi nenedi!
Ento nen ba rwo pa jatic peri, man ba kwac pare, E Yehova Mungu para, kara iwinj ba ywak ku rwo ma jatic peri berwo ko i weng’i tin;
kara weng’i bed ayaba yo ba ot maeni diewor ku dieceng’, en e ba ka m’iwacu pire kumae, Nyinga bibedo keca; kara iwinj ba rwo ma jatic peri birwo yo ba ka maeni.
Man iwinj kwac ma jatic peri kwayu, man mi dhanu peri Israel, kinde ma gibirwo yo ba ka maeni: eyo, winj i polo ma kabedo peri; man kinde m’iwinjo, wek lembe woko.
Tek ng’atu moko dubo ni jadhugola pare, man tek juketho kwong’ i wie kara uketh ekwong’ kwong’, man ebino ekwong’o i wang’ pemblam peri i ot maeni;
ilund iwinj i polo, man itim, man ipok lembe mi jutic peri, m’igonj ko judubo, kara udwok yo pare i wie gire, m’igony ko lembe de ma wi weg bedopwe, kara imi ire calku bedopwe pare.
Kinde ma jugoyo dhanu peri Israel piny i wang’ jadegi, kum gidubo iri; tek gilokri kendo i beng’i, man gituco nyingi, e girwo man gikwei i ot maeni:
ilund iwinj kud i polo, man iwek dubo mi dhanu peri Israel, man idwokgi kendo i ng’om m’imio ni kwarugi.
Kinde ma polo kang’, man koth umbe, kum gidubo iri; tek girwo yo ba ka maeni, man gituco nyingi, gilokri de ni dubo migi, kinde m’ipcnjogi:
ilund iwinj kud i polo, man iwek dubo mi jutic peri woko, man mi dhanu peri Israel, kinde m’iponjogi ku yo ma ber ma maku giwoth i ie; man ior koth wi ng’om peri, m’imio ni dhanu peri ni aba.

Tek ndru bedo i ng’om, tek thong’om ubedo nuti, tek laimo kadi motho bedo nuti, bonyo de kadi ukokoubolo; tek jadegi migi tiekogi kud ali i ng’om mir adhura migi; thong’om moko ma tek nuti, tho moko de ma tek nuti;
rwo ku kwac moko ma tek ng’atu moko timo, kadi dhanu peri Israel ceke, ku ba dhanu ceke ma bing’eyo tho mir adundene gire, man ebithang’u cinge yo ba ot maeni:

ilund iwinj kud i polo ma kabedo peri, man iwek lembene woko, man itim, imi ni dhanu de kubang’gi kubang’gi ng’atuman calku yo pare, m’ing’eyo adundene; (kum in, in i kendi, ing’eyo adunde mi nyithi dhanu ceke;)
kara gilwori i nindo ceke ma gibedo ie i ng’om m’imio ni kwaruwa.
Mange ke pi jawirok, ma en e mi dhanu peri Israel ungo, kinde m’ebiai kud i ng’om ma bor pi nyingi
(kum gibiwinjo pi nyingi ma dwong’, man pi cingi ma tek, man pi boti m’urieire); kinde m’ebibino man ebirwo yo ba ot maeni;

iwinj kud i polo ma kabedo peri, man itim calku gin ceke ma welo lwong’i pire; kara dhanu ceke m’i ng’om ging’ei nyingi, kara gilwori, calu dhanu peri Israel, man kara ging’ei nia ot maeni m’agomo ulwongre ku nyingi.
Tek dhanu peri cidho woko ni lwiny kum jadegi migi, ku yo moko ma tek ibiorogi, man girwo ni Yehova yo bang’ adhura m’igoyo wie, man yo ba ot m’agomo pi nyingi;
ilund iwinj rwo migi ku kwac migi kud i polo, man icung kum lembe migi.
Tek gidubo iri (kum ng’atu moko mbe ma dubo ngo), man ng’ecwiny unegi i kumgi, man imiogi ni jadegi, ketho nia giyakugi man giterogi ni ng’eca i ng’om pa jadegi, bor kadi ceng’ni;
ento tek gibipoi gigi i ng’om ma juterogi i ie ni ng’eca, man gilokri kendo, e gikwei i ng’om mi ju m’uterogi ni ng’eca, gibiwacu kumae, Wadubo, wacamu co, watimo rac;

tek gidwogo i beng’i kud adundegi ceke man ku ng’eyong’ec migi ceke i ng’om mi judegi migi, m’uterogi ni ng’eca, man girwo i beng’i yo ba ng’om migi, m’imio ni kwarugi, adhura m’igoyo wie, man ot m’agomo pi nyingi:
ilund iwinj rwo migi ku kwac migi i polo ma kabedo peri, man icung kum lembe migi;
man iwek lembe mi dhanu peri m’udubo iri, man dubo migi ceke ma gidubo ie iri; e imi igi ngisi i wang’ ju m’uterogi ni ng’eca, kara ngisi neggi i kumgi
(kum gi dhanu peri, man aba peri, m’iwodho woko kud i Misiri, kud i dier uka mi nyunyu);
kara weng’i bed ayaba yo ba kwac pa jatic peri, man ba kwac mi dhanu peri Israel, kara iwinj gi i nindo ceke ma tek gilwong’i i ie.
Kum ikoyogi ku kind kodhi dhanu ceke m’i ng’om, kara gibed ni aba peri, calu iyero ku dhu Musa ma jatic peri, kinde m’iwodho kwaruwa woko kud i Misiri, E Rwoth Yehova.
Man ebedo kumeno, nia, kinde ma Suleman udaru timo rwo maeni ceke ku kwac ba Yehova, eai malu kud i wang’ pemblam pa Yehova, kud i rum ma wi conge m’ethang’u ko cinge yor i polo.
Man ecungo, e emio mugisa ni cokri ceke mir Israel ku dwande ma tek, ewacu kumae,
Mugisa ni Yehova, m’emio yom ni dhanu pare Israel, calku gin ceke m’eng’olo: lembe acel de mbe m’udong’ mi lembang’ola pare ceke ma ber, m’eng’olo ku dhu Musa ma jatic pare.
Yehova Mungu mwa bed kudwa, calu ebedo ku kwaruwa: kud ewekwa, kadi kud ekunwa;
kara enyeb adundewa i bang’e, kara wawoth i yo pare ceke, man kara watim lembang’ola pare, ku cik pare, ku lembapoka pare, m’eng’olo ni kwaruwa.

Man wek lembe para maeni, m’atimo kudo kwac i wang’ Yehova, ubed ceng’ni ba Yehova Mungu mwa dieceng’ ku diewor, kara ecung kum lembe pa jatic pare, man kum lembe mi dhanu pare Israel, calu ma cande bibedo nuti ceng’ ku ceng’;
kara kodhidhanu ceke m’i ng’om ung’ei nia Yehova, en e Mungu; mange mbe.
Ka kumeno wuwek adundewu bed ndhu cu ku Yehova Mungu mwa, mi wotho i cik pare, man mi timo lembang’ola pare, calu i ceng’ ma tin.
Man ubimo, gikud Israel ceke, githiero lam i wang’ Yehova.
Man Suleman uthiero koni dhiang’ rubanga pier ario, ku rombe rubanga dak acel ku pier ario ni Yehova, ni lam mi kwiocwiny. Kum kumeno ubimo ku nyithindho mir Israel ceke githiero ot pa Yehova.

Ceng’ maeca ubimo dwoko die lelagang’ ma ni i wang’ot pa Yehova leng’; kum ethiero lam m’awang’a keca, ku lam mi mogo, ku mio mi lam mi kwiocwiny, kum pemblam mi mola ma ni i wang’ Yehova e nok hai mi romo ku lam m’awang’a, man lam mi mogo, ku mio mi lam mi kwiocwiny.

Kum kumeno Suleman uketho agba i nindo maeca, gikud Israel ceke, cokri ma dit, ugambre i kamondo mi Hamath cil kum kulo mi Misiri, i wang’ Yehova Mungu mwa, ceng’ abiro man ceng’ abiro, en e ceng’ apar wi ang’wen.

I ceng’ mir aborane elalu dhanu; man gimio mugisa ni ubimo, e gicidho ba hema migi ma mutoro kud anyong’a de nego adundegi kum bero ceke ma Yehova nyutho ni Daudi ma jatic pare, man ni Israel ma dhanu pare.
